The **Pole Hook** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A large fish hook fitted onto a long wooden pole to create a fishing implement for hauling in fish that is equally effective as a melee weapon. An upgrade lashes three additional hooks on the end of the pole, which provides increased damage and armor penetration.
